s: Din hahaptara ubirkoteha ubo y"d seipim: hammaptir benabi lo yipchot mik"a pesuqim beshabbat, sheshshiba olim liqrot battora, vetzarik sheyyaptir benabi g' pesuqim keneged kol echad mehaolim, mippene sheppaam achat gazeru shemad al yisrael shello yiqreu battora, veqareu binbiim meinyan happarasha shiba keneged hashshiba shehayu tzerikim liqrot battora, velo hayu pochatin mig' pesuqim lekol echad kemo sheen pochatin battora, vahare ben kullam k"a pesuqim, veachar kak keshebbotla haggezera vechazeru liqrot battora — hitqinu sheyyehe echad qore benabi meinyan happarasha k"a pesuqim beshabbat. Abal beyom tob day bet"v pesuqim, keneged Hashem haolim battora. Veim nishlam hainyan bepachot mik"a, o bepachot mit"v, kegon parashat "shuba" shehi qetanna, o kegon "parashat olotekem sepu al zibchekem vego'" — en tzarik lehashlim meinyan acher (lo shemmillepanayv velo shemmilleacharayv):

Vetiqqenu sheyyebarek hammaptir z' berakot keneged shiba sheqqareu battora, shette berakot shebberak al hattora sheqqore qodem sheyyaptir benabi, kemo shennitbaer besimman rp"b, vechamesh berakot mebarek al hahaptara, achat millepaneha ved' leachareha. Veen laanot "amen" achar "emet vatzedeq", sheen sham siyyum habberaka. Umippene sheharbeh toim laanot sham "amen", laken tob lammaptir shello laasot sham shum hepseq kelal, lemaan yedeu sheen sham siyyum beraka:

Lo nitqena hahaptara ella betzibbur achar sheqqareu beseper tora, abal im lo qareu beseper tora ella bechummash belo beraka, kemo shennitbaer besimman qm"g — lo yomar hahaptara im birkoteha. Abal belo birkoteha yekolim leomrah. Venakon haddabar sheyyomruha, shello tishtakkach lahem torat hahaptara. Abal im qara beseper tora pasul, veal derek shennitbaer besimman qm"g — yomru hahaptara im birkoteha, kemo shennitbaer sham:

Ap al pi shesseper tora hechaser apillu ot achat en qorin bo, abal behaptara en tzarik sheyyehe hannabi shemmaptirim bo seper shalem, ella day beparasha shemmaptirin bah (kede shello yiqra beal peh debarim shebbiktab). Veap im gam parasha zo eno ketuba kemishpat ketibat sipre hannebiim bime chakme haggemara, dehaynu al haggevil o al haqqelap shel or behema tehora, veasuy biglila keseper tora, kemo shekkatub beyoreh dea simman ra"a, ap al pi ken (hayu) yekolim lehaptir bah (ap bimehem), shehahaptara lo nitqena kelal sheyyiqrauha beseper kasher kemo shettiqqenu biqriat hattora liqrot beseper tora kasher, ella sheasur liqrotah al peh. Veap shebbimehem haya asur liktob parashiyyot parashiyyot bipne atzman kol sheenan seper shalem, ben shehen min hattora, ben shehen minnebiim uketubim, kemo shekkatub beyoreh dea simman rp"g, ap al pi ken hittiru liktob haptarot, mishshum "et laasot laHashem heperu torateka", sheen yekolet beyad kol tzibbur liqnot lahem nebiim shelemim veyitbattelu miqqeriat hahaptara legamre. Veap sheakshav shennitgallet meleket haddepus vehasseparim bezol, ap al pi ken muttar lehadpis o liktob hahaptarot bilbaddan, lepi sheap im yadpisu seper nabi shalem al hanneyar lo yihyeh muttar liqrot bo ella mishshum "et laasot laHashem", kevan sheeno al or behema tehora veeno asuy biglila. Veap im behaptara zo hannidpeset o hakketuba yesh bah chesron harbeh tebot — qore hachissaron beal peh, im hu beinyan sheen issur mishshum "debarim shebbiktab i atta rashshay leomram beal peh" (ayyen simman qm"g):

Veim en hahaptara kelal bebet hakkeneset ella bebayit acher, vei epshar lahabiah mishsham sheen erub bair — yeleku asara mibbet hakkeneset leoto bayit, veyaptir sham hammaptir sheqqara battora techilla bebet hakkeneset, abal lo yiqra hahaptara beal peh bebet hakkeneset:

Rosh chodesh shechal lihyot beshabbat — en hammaptir mazkir inyan shel rosh chodesh kelal bebirkat "al hattora ku'", lepi sheeno inyan kelal lerosh chodesh bahaptara, shehare ilmale shabbat en haptara berosh chodesh lebad:

Tzarik lekavven lebirkot haqqoreim battora ulebirkot hammaptir, veyaaneh acharehem "amen". Veyaalu lo lehashlim minyan mea berakot shechaser minyanam beshabbat, im en lo perot harbeh lehashlim bahem, kemo shennitbaer besimman m"v, veayyen simman r"tz:

Qatan hayyodea liqrot, sheyyodea lachtok haotiyyot betob, veyodea lemi mebarekin — yakol lehaptir benabi. Veyesh nohagim silsul vekabod bemerkaba shel yechezqel shemaptirin baatzeret ubeshirat david keshemmaptirim otah bez' shel pesach, shello yaptir ella gadol. Veyesh nohagim ken gam beshabbat "shuba":

Im qareu qatan lemaptir veqara battora, venimtza sheeno yodea lomar hahaptara, veken im era ken begadol — yakol acher leomrah. Veen tzarik liqrot battora od, ki day baqqeria harishona, sheap shettiqqenu shehammaptir benabi yiqra battora techilla mippene kebod hattora shettehe niqret qodem hannabi, kemo shennitbaer besimman rp"b, mikkol maqom gam keshehaqqatan o acher qara battora yesh bazeh gam ken kabod lattora, shennikkar haddabar lakkol sheqqara bishbil hahaptara shettihyeh niqret achar qeria battora, shebbevadday lo yabou lomar sheqqara bishbil atzmo velo bishbil hahaptara, shehare kebar nishlemu haqqeruim veameru qaddish acharehem. Veyesh choleqin al zeh. Lepikak, lekattechilla asur laasot ken liqrot lemaptir mi sheeno yodea lomar hahaptara beatzmo. Veim qareu oto — yaaleh veyiqra battora veyiqra acher hahaptara kassebara harishona:

Im nishtatteq hammaptir beemtza hahaptara — dino kemo beseper tora, shehabba lesayyem tachtayv lo yatchil mimmaqom sheppasaq harishon, ella tzarik lachazor ulehatchil mimmaqom shehitchil harishon, kemo shennitbaer besimman q"m (veayyen sham im tzarik lachazor ulebarek battechilla):

Lo yatchil hammaptir lehaptir ad sheyyigmor haggolel liglol hasseper tora, kede sheggam haggolel yukal lehabin velishmoa mimmennu, shechoba hi al hakkol lishmoa hahaptara kemo happarasha shebbeseper tora. Lepikak, lo yiqreu shenayim hahaptara keechad beqol ram, sheshshene qolot en nishmaim. Veyesh nohagim mittaam hayyadua lahem shello lismok al shemia bilbaddah, ella hem beatzmam qorin hahaptara, veshomein habberakot mippi hammaptir. Umikkol maqom, tzerikim lizzaher shello yiqreu beqol ram ella benachat (milla bemilla im hammaptir, ayyen simman qp"g):
En lesalleq seper hannebiim millipne hammaptir ad leachar sheyyigmor lebarek acharayv, kede sheyyireh vibarek al mah shehiptir:

Bekol shabbat sheqqorin b' parashiyyot battora maptirim haptara shel parasha hashsheniyya shebba mesayyemin, ubah qore hammaptir techilla, chutz mishshabbat sheqqorim "achare mot" u"qedoshim", shemmaptirim haptarat "achare mot", kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tk"ch:

Nahagu lehazkir achar qeriat hattora nishmat hammetim ulebarek haoseqim betzorke tzibbur, vekol maqom lepi minhago. Venohagim lomar "yequm pureqan". Veen bekol zeh mishshum issur techinna beshabbat, sheen zo techinna ella beraka. Gam nohagim lomar "ab harachamim". Ubekol yom sheen omerim bo "tzidqateka-vetzidqateka-tzidqateka" — en omerim oto, veen mazkirim neshamot. Veken kesheyyesh chatunna o mila. Veyesh meqomot sheen omerim oto keshemmebarekin hachodesh, veen mazkirin neshamot ella lemi shenniqbar beoto shabua. Ubime hassepira, keshemmebarekin rosh chodesh iyyar vesivan — omerim "ab harachamim", mippene haggezerot sheereu bayyamim hahem. Veap im era mila beshabbatot hahem — omerim oto. Abal im chal rosh chodesh beshabbatot hahem — en omerim oto. Vekol kayyotze bazeh holekim achar hamminhag:
